title: Fund44 — One application. More ways to fund your business.
metaTitle: Fund44 — One application. More ways to fund your business.
metaDescription: Explore small-business financing from $50,000 to $5 million, including SBA loans, acquisition financing, term loans, and lines of credit.
summary: Fund44 turns a fragmented financing search into one clear path so small-business owners can explore relevant funding options without starting from scratch for every lender.

hero.title: One application. More ways to fund your business.
hero.lead: Explore SBA loans, acquisition financing, term loans, and lines of credit through one clear path — without researching and reapplying lender by lender.

problem.eyebrow: The problem with shopping for capital
problem.heading: Funding a business shouldn't mean starting over five times.
problem.lead: Every lender wants a slightly different application and its own documents. Fund44 turns that scramble into a single organized path.

network.heading: Your profile, routed through a curated network.
network.lead: Fund44 launched with 44 lenders. That number is behind the name and remains the operating sweet spot for the network. Today Fund44 curates a network that typically fluctuates between 40 and 50 lenders as it removes providers that fall short of its customer-service standards and adds providers that offer competitive terms, better tools, or new financing options. The network can change over time, and the paths shown in the experience may vary by business profile, financing need, geography, and current provider participation.

commonQuestions.question: Is Fund44 a lender?
commonQuestions.answer: No. Fund44 is a technology marketplace. Financing is offered by third-party lenders in our network. Eligibility, rates, and terms are set by each lender — not by Fund44.

commonQuestions.question: What size funding does Fund44 help with?
commonQuestions.answer: Fund44 is built for U.S. small-business owners seeking roughly $50,000 to $5 million for acquisitions, owner-occupied real estate, working capital, equipment, expansion, or refinancing.

commonQuestions.question: Does checking my options affect my credit?
commonQuestions.answer: Checking your initial options can use information that does not affect your credit score. If you choose to proceed with a specific lender, that lender may later perform a hard credit inquiry as part of its own underwriting.

commonQuestions.question: What products can I be matched to?
commonQuestions.answer: Coverage can include SBA 7(a) and SBA 504 loans, business acquisition financing, conventional term loans, business lines of credit, equipment financing, and invoice factoring, depending on your profile and lender availability.

commonQuestions.question: Do I have to apply separately with each lender?
commonQuestions.answer: No — that is the point of Fund44. You share your profile and documents once, and Fund44 routes them to relevant lenders so you can compare paths without starting over each time.
